description: Agent Insurance: submit one policy’s deductible terms with what the buyer was told: the policy with its currency, the deductible as recorded, whether it applies to each claim or once in the aggregate, when it is owed (deducted from the payment, paid before the payment or billed after it), when the policy was bought and the deductible terms as written; and what the buyer was told, with where (the quote, the sales page or a message), when, the currency, the same amount, form and timing, and the text, read for wording such as no deductible, nothing out of pocket or fully covered. The signed report gives the policy, what was told, every point with the policy beside the telling, whether they match and whether the buyer was told more or less favorably than the policy, the promising wording found with what the policy contradicts, and the day the buyer was told against the day the policy was bought, and counts them, and names a misstated deductible: a deductible told lower than the policy records, a deductible told as aggregate where the policy applies it to each claim, a deductible told as owed later than the policy says, and wording that promises the buyer pays nothing where the policy records a deductible; then terms told more strictly than the policy, a deductible first stated after the policy was bought and an amount told in another currency, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. Nothing told, no deductible term told, no deductible or form in the policy, no timing in the policy where one was told or no date for the telling or the purchase leaves the deductible unverified. This reads one policy’s deductible against what the buyer was told: a counterparty’s policy excerpt read as diligence evidence is wever_insurance-evidence-check, a quoted amount against the settled charge is wever_price-truth-check and a fee schedule against a quote or invoice is wever_fee-evidence-check. Verdict insurance_deductible_misstated, insurance_deductible_partial, insurance_deductible_unverified or insurance_deductible_as_stated. POST /api/insurance-deductible-check. Reads the insurance records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment, claim filing, coverage binding or external write. Agent Insurance reads an insurance policy after the fact, from the subject’s own records: the coverage against the insured activity, the exclusions against the activity and its parts, the limits against the stated exposure, the deductible against what the buyer was told, the claims deadlines against an incident, a certificate against the policy it was issued from, incident notice under the policy and a renewal against the expiring policy. Beside it, wever_insurance-evidence-check reads a counterparty’s insurance certificate or policy excerpt as diligence evidence and reports what that material establishes against required coverages, limits and a work window, while an insurance check reads the subject’s own policy against a stated need, an incident or a certificate issued from it; wever_warranty-check reads a warranty claim against warranty terms, while an insurance check reads an insurance policy; and wever_risk-downside-check reads a planned action’s downside before it is taken, while an insurance check reads the policy behind it after the fact. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-insurance-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-insurance/.
